about_the_game:
Official DLC for "RPG Maker MZ and MV" brought to you by North Sound, the company that provided various soundtracks included in RPG Maker MZ and MV!

It contains a whopping 24 soundtracks for various scenes, including fantasy, dark fantasy, modern style, and ethnic style!

Also included are 20 ME tracks that match different types of scenes!

This is the ultimate pack for those looking to create an immersive and thrilling story!

 

Contents

*****

BGM: 1

Theme music: 2

Music for battle: 5

Music for end of battle: 3

Music for inside the castle: 1

Music for dungeon: 3

Field music: 3

Music for scene: 3

Music for town: 3

Music for vehicles: 1

 

ME: 20

 

Total 44 tracks

*****

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
